headline: 英國文化界AI憂心與劇場實驗
context: 英國作家兼學者凱瑟琳・朗德爾（Katherine Rundell）投書談教育站在十字路口，批評 AI 正在影響年輕人的心智與快樂。同一時間，愛丁堡國際藝術節的舞台上，《毒梟》主角瓦格納・莫拉（Wagner Moura）與導演克莉斯汀・亞塔伊（Christiane Jatahy），把易卜生（Ibsen）1882 年的劇作改編成打破第四面牆的審判劇場。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Education is at a crossroads, argues the author and academic. Should we embrace new technology in the name of efficiency, or is it time to fight back? If you set out to design from scratch a tool to facilitate authoritarian rule, it would look exactly like AI. You would cherish it for its ability to destabilise our shared reality and its creation of disinformation on a scale unprecedented in human history. With it you need no armies of typists and artists to spread your propaganda. It can enable mass surveillance and thereby put shackles on those who seek to resist you. Its lethal autonomous weapons systems can perfect and normalise remote killing. It will turbocharge inequality; it is already facilitating a breathtaking shift of power and wealth from the hands of the many to the hands of a tiny number of men who – to put it in terms for which I can’t be sued – seem to hold dangerously damaged views about the value and dignity of human life. AI could be a magnificent thing. It could revolutionise medicine, speed the cure of cancer, assist disabled people, transform the way we are able to understand data, democratise access to the law, bolster disaster early warning systems and uncover hitherto unimagined truths about the Earth’s ecosystems. But if it ends up in the hands of crooks and despots that will be completely irrelevant. Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘I hate what AI is doing to the minds and happiness of the young’: Katherine Rundell on the view from the classroom

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Lyceum theatre, Edinburgh At the Edinburgh international festival, the Narcos star and director Christiane Jatahy transform the 1882 classic into a resonant, fourth wall-breaking event This dramatised trial takes Henrik Ibsen’s 1882 play about a man’s campaign to expose the secret scandal of contaminated water in his town and turns it into a modern day interrogation: of speaking out versus remaining silent, of a family at war and of fiction and reality itself. In fact, is this a drama at all? It starts off as such but minutes later, the celebrated Brazilian screen actor Wagner Moura , playing Ibsen’s Thomas Stockmann, seemingly breaks character to talk to us directly. Stockmann still sits invisibly on stage and we as an audience are here to judge him, he says, before returning to inhabit him. Continue reading...
sources.title: A Trial: After An Enemy of the People review – Wagner Moura upends Ibsen and keeps us guessing

英國文化圈這頭談 AI 焦慮，那頭玩劇場實驗

英國作家凱瑟琳・朗德爾投書談教育站在十字路口，她批評 AI 正在影響年輕人的心智與快樂，質疑該不該為了效率全面擁抱科技。同一時間，愛丁堡國際藝術節上，《毒梟》主角瓦格納・莫拉與導演克莉斯汀・亞塔伊，把易卜生 1882 年的劇作改編成打破第四面牆的審判劇場，持續留住觀眾的目光。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 8 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

英國文化圈這頭談 AI 焦慮，那頭玩劇場實驗。

英國作家兼學者凱瑟琳・朗德爾（Katherine Rundell）投書談教育站在十字路口，她批評 AI 正在影響年輕人的心智與快樂，質疑教育界該不該為了效率全面擁抱科技。同一時間，愛丁堡國際藝術節的舞台上，《毒梟》主角瓦格納・莫拉（Wagner Moura）與導演克莉斯汀・亞塔伊（Christiane Jatahy），把易卜生（Ibsen）1882 年的劇作改編成打破第四面牆的審判劇場，持續留住觀眾的目光。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 8 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 英國文化圈，這頭在擔心 AI，那頭在玩劇場實驗。作家凱瑟琳・朗德爾投書說，教育現在站在十字路口，她擔心 AI 正在影響年輕人的心智與快樂。同一時間，愛丁堡國際藝術節的舞台上，有一齣戲把易卜生一八八二年的劇作，改編成打破第四面牆的審判劇場，持續留住觀眾的目光。
